slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: 关于目标函数，这个农场经营计划是要最大化年度总净收入（作物收入 + 奶牛收入 + 鸡收入 + 外出打工收入），还是有其他目标（比如最小化成本、最大化利润等）？
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is to maximize annual total net income.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P0 slot was resolved by turn 8, but the agent never entered READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; instead it repeated the same already-answered question through turn 30.

summary: The agent recovered the key hidden objective slot, but then became stuck in a repetitive loop asking the same already-resolved question many times and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
